description: This Java source file defines an Android IntentService class named RSSPullService, responsible for fetching and parsing RSS feed data from a URL provided via Intent. It manages network connections, caches metadata about modifications, and stores parsed image data into a content provider. The class also broadcasts its processing states to other components.

classes.name: RSSPullService
classes.description: An IntentService subclass for asynchronously fetching, parsing, and storing RSS feed data from a specified URL, while broadcasting its status.

methods.name: RSSPullService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the IntentService with the name 'RSSPullService'.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Main method executed when the service handles an Intent, responsible for connecting to the RSS feed URL, checking for updates, parsing XML data, storing images, and broadcasting progress/status.
